| description = Is in fact not actually a rogue.

A named iksar for the [[Shaman Skull Quests|Shaman Skull Quest No. 2]] Iksar shaman quest.  To get him to spawn, kill all the Iksar brigands east of Kurn's tower, there are 4-5 spawns between the desert and the grassy area looking east.  Beware: the scaled wolf hunter/tracker mobs will see him and kill him very quickly, so you have to keep looking.

The rogue shaman in Warslik's Woods spawns just to the east of #4 on the map at (+2759, -3420), hiding behind a tree. His placeholder is an iksar brigand.
